title: SaaS / Identity Trust Chain Model

scope: Read-only SaaS and identity trust-chain modeling from imported configuration and evidence.
generation_reason: Modern incidents often follow SaaS and identity trust chains, so AegisPT needs evidence-backed modeling without token use or live SaaS mutation.
